title: T3 Reference: on-load history

ON-LOAD GATE FALSE-STALE SAGA (2026-06-24..28, consolidated from on-load T1 during the 2026-06-28 slim -- moved here because it is HISTORY, not a session-start decision rule). SYMPTOM: the on-load reflex-read enforcement gate (wkharness-guards-onload-enforce.ps1 + -demix.ps1) false-blocked real work with 'reflex reads BEFORE last compaction -- stale' even when the mandatory reads WERE done this session. TIMELINE: (1) 06-24 first reported, same class as the study-lock false-UNREAD-after-compaction; (2) 06-26 timing-fix v1 + v2 inserted a studied-index re-query (T1 since=MAX(compaction,session-start), T2 no-since) before the stale-return; (3) 06-27 found v2 INOPERATIVE -- Get-WkStudiedFromIndex is not loaded in the guard runtime scope (lazy dot-source fails), so control falls to the same-turn-only Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds which cannot see prior-turn reads -> cross-turn reads look stale; (4) interim FIX = fail-OPEN at the stale-block INSIDE if(haveAll) (non-demix L387 cfa327c6, demix L338) -- the reads provably exist this session, so never false-deny on positive evidence; (5) 06-27 also fixed Test-WkIsPureKnowledgeOpChain L91 to allow 'add' (read|search|contribute|edit|add) so 'wkappbot skill add' is not on-load-blocked. REAL ROOT CAUSE (06-27 Sonnet sector, REAL JSONL evidence, supersedes the 'type==summary too loose' hypothesis): '"type":"summary"' is DEAD CODE (matches ZERO real entries -- Claude never emits it); real compaction = a compact_boundary system entry + an isCompactSummary user entry ~15s skew. The false-stale was ENTIRELY the unwired Get-WkStudiedFromIndex. TWO-PART REAL FIX (pending): (A) safe-delete the dead 'type -eq summary' arm in both files; (B) wire Get-WkStudiedFromIndex into guard scope (the SQLite studied-index endgame, hippocampus-living-memory-howto step 21-22) OR add a 'wkhippo studied --ids --since --jsonl' subprocess re-query so it does not depend on in-process function availability. CALIBRATION LESSON: the predecessor and successors all HYPOTHESIZED type==summary; an investigation sector with real JSONL proved it dead -- investigate-with-evidence before fixing a hypothesis. Cross: harness-gate-log-data-integrity, hippocampus-living-memory-howto step 21-22, verify-tool-or-guard-synthetic-live-static.
